name: Sala Danang Beach Hotel
vi: Khách sạn Sala Danang Beach, 36-38 Lâm Hoành, Phước Mỹ, Sơn Trà
addr: 36-38 Lâm Hoành, Phước Mỹ, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng 550000
hours: Check-in from 14:00; check-out by 12:00 (early/late on request, fee)
tip: Not on Võ Nguyên Giáp itself: one block back, ~5 min walk to the sand. Bag drop at 10:15 is before check-in, so message the hotel the day before.

name: Cồn Market (Chợ Cồn) food court
vi: Chợ Cồn, 290 Hùng Vương / 318 Ông Ích Khiêm, Hải Châu
addr: 290 Hùng Vương (also listed 318 Ông Ích Khiêm), Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
hours: Daily 07:00–19:00; indoor food hall (Đình 15/15A) all day, a few stalls to ~21:00; extra street stalls set up from ~15:00
tip: Cash only, small notes. Kem bơ is inside the food hall: Kem Bơ Cô Hà (Lô 45B, Đình 15A, 07:00–19:00) or Kem Bơ Cô Thu (Lô 47, Đình 15, to 19:00, from 25k).

name: Kem Bơ Cô Vân (actual location: Bắc Mỹ An market)
vi: Kem bơ Cô Vân, khu ăn uống lô AU20-22 Chợ Bắc Mỹ An, 25 Nguyễn Bá Lân, Mỹ An
addr: Lô AU20-21-22, Chợ Bắc Mỹ An, 25 Nguyễn Bá Lân, Mỹ An, Ngũ Hành Sơn
price: 8,000–10,000 VND (older listing); 30,000–45,000 VND for 200–400 ml cups (recent)
tip: It is NOT in Cồn Market. 1.3 km from XLIII Coffee: do it Sunday after coffee, before 18:00.

name: Da Nang Cathedral (Pink Church / Nhà thờ Con Gà)
vi: Nhà thờ Chính tòa Đà Nẵng, 156 Trần Phú (cổng sau 156 Yên Bái)
addr: 156 Trần Phú, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
hours: Sightseeing Mon–Sat 08:00–11:30 & 13:30–16:30; Sat Mass 05:00 and 17:15; Sun Mass 05:30, 08:00, 10:00 (English), 15:00, 16:30, 18:00 — closed to sightseeing on Sundays; confessions Thu & Sat 14:30–16:00
tip: Sat 13:45–14:45 slot is fine. Anyone selling tickets outside is a scam. Shoulders/knees covered.

name: Han Market (Chợ Hàn)
vi: Chợ Hàn, 119 Trần Phú, Hải Châu
addr: 119 Trần Phú, Hải Châu 1, Đà Nẵng
hours: Daily 06:00–19:00; food stalls wind down from ~18:00
tip: 400 m from the cathedral. Ground floor food/dried goods, upstairs clothes; bargain from ~60%.

name: Cộng Cà Phê – Bạch Đằng
vi: Cộng Cà Phê, 96-98 Bạch Đằng, Hải Châu 1
addr: 96-98 Bạch Đằng, Hải Châu 1, Đà Nẵng
tip: Riverside, 150 m from Han Market. Order cốt dừa cà phê (coconut coffee); upstairs window seats for the river photo.

name: Hải Sản Năm Đảnh
vi: Quán hải sản Năm Đảnh, K139/H59/38 Trần Quang Khải, Thọ Quang, Sơn Trà
addr: K139/H59/38 Trần Quang Khải, Thọ Quang, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng
hours: 09:30–21:00 (Foody: 10:00–22:00) — but on weekends/peak season it stops seating around 18:00 once stock runs out
tip: Saturday: be seated by 17:00, not 17:30. Cars do reach it (parking on site); tell the driver 'quán Năm Đảnh' — they all know it.

name: Hải Sản Bé Mặn (alternative)
vi: Hải sản Bé Mặn, Lô 8-9 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Mân Thái, Sơn Trà
addr: Lô 8-9 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Mân Thái, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng
price: Priced per 100 g: oysters 59k, stone crab 89k, scallops 120k, lobster 240k, king crab 290k
tip: Michelin Selected; 18:00–21:00 fills up, book. Easier Grab access than Năm Đảnh (main beach road).

name: Dragon Bridge fire & water show — east-bank viewpoint
vi: Cầu Rồng, bờ đông, đường Trần Hưng Đạo, gần tượng Cá Chép Hóa Rồng
addr: Trần Hưng Đạo promenade at the Cá Chép Hóa Rồng statue / Cầu Tình Yêu, An Hải Trung, Sơn Trà
hours: Show Fri, Sat, Sun 21:00 (plus public holidays); fire then water, ~15 min. Confirmed still Fri–Sun 21:00 in Aug-2026 reporting.
tip: Bridge closed to vehicles ~20:45–21:30. Stand on the east bank near the dragon's head for fire; the water spray lands on the bridge deck, so the promenade stays dry.

name: XLIII Coffee (ex-43 Factory Coffee Roaster)
vi: XLIII Coffee, Lô 422 Ngô Thì Sĩ, Ngũ Hành Sơn
addr: Lô 422 Ngô Thì Sĩ, Bắc Mỹ An, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng
tip: Same address as the old 43 Factory; brand renamed, not moved. Glass-house roastery; go early Sunday for light and seats.

name: Trình Cà Phê – 25 Phạm Hồng Thái
vi: Trình Cà Phê, 25 Phạm Hồng Thái, Hải Châu (gần Nhà thờ Con Gà)
addr: 25 Phạm Hồng Thái, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
hours: Open late to 01:30 (opening time not published); other branches 06:30–22:30 (Kiot Z04 Bạch Đằng walking street) and 24/7 (111 Nguyễn Hữu Thọ)
tip: 350 m from the cathedral, so it doubles as the Saturday dessert stop (cà phê bơ, kem bơ) rather than a Sunday detour.

name: Bánh Xèo Bà Dưỡng
vi: Bánh xèo Bà Dưỡng, K280/23 Hoàng Diệu, Bình Hiên, Hải Châu
addr: K280/23 Hoàng Diệu, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
hours: 09:30–21:00 (some listings 21:30); no fixed weekly closing day
tip: Closed 21–26 Sep 2025 for an announced break; check the Facebook page the week before for a 2026 repeat. Alley entrance — Grab drops at the Hoàng Diệu mouth, ~60 m walk.

name: Chè Liên – 189 Hoàng Diệu
vi: Chè Liên, 189 Hoàng Diệu, Nam Dương, Hải Châu
addr: 189 Hoàng Diệu, Nam Dương, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
tip: Original branch, 250 m from Bà Dưỡng. Order chè sầu riêng (durian).

name: Mỹ Khê Beach (loungers + massage)
vi: Bãi biển Mỹ Khê, đường Võ Nguyên Giáp
addr: Võ Nguyên Giáp, Phước Mỹ, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng
hours: Loungers all day; lifeguard flags in the afternoon
price: Lounger ~40,000 VND/day; foot reflexology 300,000–450,000 VND/60 min at mid-range spas, 630,000–690,000 at Herbal/Dahan
tip: Late Sept is rainy-season onset: swim only between flags. For a foot massage without walking, Sum Spa is 100 m from Sala.

name: 7 Bridges Brewing Co. — Da Nang Beachside Brewery
vi: 7 Bridges Da Nang Beachside Brewery, đường Việt Bắc, Lô 03 B2.34 Khu TĐC Tân Trà, Hòa Hải, Ngũ Hành Sơn
addr: Đường Việt Bắc, Lô 03 B2.34 Khu TĐC Tân Trà, Hòa Hải, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng (Tân Trà beach, ~10 km south of Sala)
tip: The brand site's only Da Nang venue is this Tân Trà brewery; the 493 Trần Hưng Đạo riverside taproom still appears on OSM/LinkedIn (16.0633, 108.2303) but not on 7bridges.vn — phone first.

name: The Local Beans (84 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế)
vi: The Local Beans, 84 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế, Mỹ An (cũng có 56A Lê Hồng Phong và 186-190 Phan Châu Trinh)
addr: 84 Châu Thị Vĩnh Tế, Mỹ An, Ngũ Hành Sơn; also 56A Lê Hồng Phong and 186-188-190 Phan Châu Trinh, Hải Châu
tip: All three sell roasted beans retail. Lê Hồng Phong (16.0641, 108.2203) is closer to DAD.

name: Da Nang International Airport — Terminal 2 (international)
vi: Nhà ga quốc tế T2, Sân bay Đà Nẵng, Nguyễn Văn Linh
addr: Nhà ga Quốc tế T2, Sân bay Đà Nẵng, Hòa Cường, Đà Nẵng
hours: VietJet international counters open 3 h and close 50 min before departure (airport guide: 60 min) — for VJ889 13:10 that is 12:10–12:20 at the latest
tip: Select 'International Terminal (T2)' in Grab; drop-off ramp is at the departures level. Online check-in still requires document verification at the counter at least 60 min before.

name: Sun World Bà Nà Hills (optional)
vi: Sun World Bà Nà Hills, xã Hòa Ninh, Hòa Vang
addr: Hòa Ninh, Hòa Vang, Đà Nẵng (~40 km / 50–60 min from Sala)
price: 750,000 VND adult, 600,000 child; 1,250,000 with buffet lunch
tip: Golden Bridge and the French village involve 2–3 h on foot and stairs; it is not a zero-effort day, and it would swallow the whole Sunday.

name: Mì Quảng 1A
vi: Mì Quảng 1A, 1A Hải Phòng, Hải Châu
addr: 1A Hải Phòng, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
tip: Michelin-listed; sells out of some toppings mid-afternoon.
why: Proper sit-down mì Quảng 700 m from Cồn Market if the market stall is a letdown.

name: Bánh Mì Cô Tiên
vi: Bánh mì Cô Tiên, kiệt 80/10 Trần Phú, Hải Châu
addr: K80/10 Trần Phú, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
tip: Alley stall; Grab drops at 80 Trần Phú.
why: Daytime bánh mì 200 m from Han Market.

name: Nam House Café
vi: Nam House Cafe, 15/1 Lê Hồng Phong, Hải Châu
addr: 15/1 Lê Hồng Phong, Phước Ninh, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
tip: Small; go before 10:00 or after 15:00 for the antique-filled rooms without a queue.
why: The vintage 'time capsule' café that fills Xiaohongshu/Instagram feeds, 600 m from the cathedral.

name: Dreamer Coffee
vi: Dreamer, 230 Nguyễn Công Trứ, An Hải Bắc, Sơn Trà
addr: 230 Nguyễn Công Trứ, An Hải Bắc, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng
tip: Camper-van and plants; morning light is best.
why: Photo café 1 km from Sala for a low-effort Sunday/Monday morning coffee.

name: The Hideout Café
vi: The Hideout Cafe, 57 Ngô Thị Sĩ, Mỹ An
addr: 57 Ngô Thị Sĩ, Mỹ An, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng
tip: Same building as Happy Heart Café (closed Sunday); Hideout is the one open.
why: Real breakfast (eggs, smoothie bowls) 150 m from XLIII.

name: Sum Spa & Massage
vi: Sum Spa, 15 Lâm Hoành, Phước Mỹ, Sơn Trà
addr: 15 Lâm Hoành, Phước Mỹ, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng
tip: Book a 17:30 slot after the beach; Herbal Spa (201 Dương Đình Nghệ, 09:00–22:30, foot 630k/60 min) is the bigger-name alternative 1 km away.
why: Foot reflexology on the same street as Sala.

name: Linh Ứng Pagoda (Bãi Bụt) viewpoint + Cà Phê Viu
vi: Chùa Linh Ứng Bãi Bụt, đường Hoàng Sa, Thọ Quang, Sơn Trà
addr: Hoàng Sa, Thọ Quang, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng
tip: Sunset ~17:45 on 26 Sep. Grab up at 16:30, 20 min at the car-park terrace or Cà Phê Viu beside the gate, back down to Năm Đảnh (4 km) by 17:15–17:30.
why: The only Sơn Trà sunset panorama with a paved car park at the terrace — city, bay and Lady Buddha with no climbing.

name: Sơn Trà Marina
vi: Sơn Trà Marina, đường Hoàng Sa (Hồ Xanh), Thọ Quang, Sơn Trà
addr: Hoàng Sa (Hồ Xanh), Thọ Quang, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng
price: 50,000–100,000 VND drinks; 81,000–300,000 on the food menu
tip: Terraces over the water; drive-in, flat.
why: Sea-view café/bar that is all over Xiaohongshu, on the road between Bé Mặn and Năm Đảnh.

name: Amy Paradise (windmill café)
vi: Amy Paradise, 100 Nguyễn Hữu An, Nại Hiên Đông, Sơn Trà
addr: 100 Nguyễn Hữu An, Nại Hiên Đông, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng
tip: Hours not published online; best at golden hour. 4 km north of the Dragon Bridge east bank.
why: Giant Dutch windmill by the water — the current Xiaohongshu photo set.

name: Rooftop À La Carte (23F, À La Carte Da Nang Beach)
vi: Rooftop À La Carte, 200 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Phước Mỹ, Sơn Trà
addr: 200 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Phước Mỹ, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng
tip: Lift straight to 23F; Horizon Bar at Four Points (120 Võ Nguyên Giáp, 36F, 10:00–01:00) is the pricier version.
why: Sea-view coffee 700 m from Sala over Mỹ Khê, Sơn Trà and Lady Buddha.
